#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the kvhttp server: assemble src/*.s and link against libSystem.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

CC=${CC:-clang}
ARCH_FLAGS=(-arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0)

rm -rf build
mkdir -p build
for src in src/*.s; do
    "$CC" "${ARCH_FLAGS[@]}" -c "$src" -o "build/$(basename "${src%.s}").o"
done
"$CC" "${ARCH_FLAGS[@]}" -Wl,-dead_strip build/*.o -o app

// conn.s — one HTTP/1.1 request per connection.
//
//   void *conn_main(void *fd)     pthread entry; owns and closes the socket.
//
// Flow: read until the header terminator, parse the request line and
// Content-Length, read the whole body, route, write one response
// (always with Content-Length and `Connection: close`), close.

    .equ HDR_CAP,   65536           // max bytes of request line + headers
    .equ MAX_BODY,  1048576         // 1 MiB value limit
    .equ IO_TIMEOUT, 30             // seconds, SO_RCVTIMEO / SO_SNDTIMEO

    .equ SOL_SOCKET,  0xffff
    .equ SO_SNDTIMEO, 0x1005
    .equ SO_RCVTIMEO, 0x1006
    .equ EINTR, 4

    .equ CH_TAB, 9
    .equ CH_LF, 10
    .equ CH_CR, 13
    .equ CH_SP, 32

    // method ids
    .equ M_OTHER, 0
    .equ M_GET, 1
    .equ M_PUT, 2
    .equ M_DELETE, 3

    // conn_main frame (sp-relative)
    .equ F_HDR,     0               // char[256] response header
    .equ F_IOV,     256             // struct iovec[2]
    .equ F_RBODY,   288             // response body ptr
    .equ F_RLEN,    296             // response body len
    .equ F_RFREE,   304             // buffer to free after responding
    .equ F_JSON,    312             // nonzero: add Content-Type: application/json
    .equ F_TV,      320             // struct timeval
    .equ F_REGS,    384
    .equ F_SIZE,    480

    .text
    .globl  _conn_main
    .p2align 2
_conn_main:
    .cfi_startproc
    sub     sp, sp, #F_SIZE
    stp     x28, x27, [sp, #F_REGS]
    stp     x26, x25, [sp, #F_REGS + 16]
    stp     x24, x23, [sp, #F_REGS + 32]
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #F_REGS + 48]
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #F_REGS + 64]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #F_REGS + 80]
    add     x29, sp, #F_REGS + 80
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    .cfi_offset w23, -56
    .cfi_offset w24, -64
    .cfi_offset w25, -72
    .cfi_offset w26, -80
    .cfi_offset w27, -88
    .cfi_offset w28, -96

    // Register roles:
    //   w19 fd           x20 header buffer    x21 bytes read / method id
    //   x22 header end   x23 method length    x24 path        x25 path length
    //   x26 Content-Length                     x27 request body x28 status
    mov     w19, w0
    mov     x20, #0
    mov     x27, #0
    stp     xzr, xzr, [sp, #F_RBODY]
    stp     xzr, xzr, [sp, #F_RFREE]

    mov     x8, #IO_TIMEOUT
    stp     x8, xzr, [sp, #F_TV]
    mov     w0, w19
    mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
    mov     w2, #SO_RCVTIMEO
    add     x3, sp, #F_TV
    mov     w4, #16
    bl      _setsockopt
    mov     w0, w19
    mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
    mov     w2, #SO_SNDTIMEO
    add     x3, sp, #F_TV
    mov     w4, #16
    bl      _setsockopt

    mov     x0, #HDR_CAP
    bl      _malloc
    cbz     x0, Lclose
    mov     x20, x0
    mov     x21, #0

    // ---- read until "\r\n\r\n" -------------------------------------------
Lread_more:
    mov     x8, #HDR_CAP
    cmp     x21, x8
    b.hs    Lbad_request
    mov     w0, w19
    add     x1, x20, x21
    sub     x2, x8, x21
    bl      _read
    cmp     x0, #0
    b.gt    Lgot_bytes
    b.eq    Lclose
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w8, [x0]
    cmp     w8, #EINTR
    b.eq    Lread_more
    b       Lclose
Lgot_bytes:
    subs    x9, x21, #3                 // rescan the last 3 old bytes
    csel    x9, x9, xzr, hs
    add     x21, x21, x0
    movz    w10, #0x0a0d
    movk    w10, #0x0a0d, lsl #16       // "\r\n\r\n" as a little-endian word
Lscan:
    add     x11, x9, #4
    cmp     x11, x21
    b.hi    Lread_more
    ldr     w12, [x20, x9]
    cmp     w12, w10
    b.eq    Lhdr_done
    add     x9, x9, #1
    b       Lscan
Lhdr_done:
    add     x22, x9, #4

    // ---- request line: METHOD SP PATH SP VERSION CRLF ----------------------
    mov     x9, #0
1:  ldrb    w10, [x20, x9]
    cmp     w10, #CH_SP
    b.eq    2f
    cmp     w10, #CH_CR
    b.eq    Lbad_request
    add     x9, x9, #1
    b       1b
2:  cbz     x9, Lbad_request
    mov     x23, x9
    add     x9, x9, #1
    add     x24, x20, x9
    mov     x10, x9
3:  ldrb    w11, [x20, x10]
    cmp     w11, #CH_SP
    b.eq    4f
    cmp     w11, #CH_CR
    b.eq    Lbad_request
    add     x10, x10, #1
    b       3b
4:  sub     x25, x10, x9
    cbz     x25, Lbad_request
5:  ldrb    w11, [x20, x10]             // skip to the first header line
    add     x10, x10, #1
    cmp     w11, #CH_LF
    b.ne    5b

    add     x0, x20, x10
    add     x1, x20, x22
    bl      Lcontent_length
    tbnz    x0, #63, Lbad_request
    mov     x26, x0
    mov     x8, #MAX_BODY
    cmp     x26, x8
    b.hi    Ltoo_large

    // ---- body -------------------------------------------------------------
    cbz     x26, Lroute
    mov     x0, x26
    bl      _malloc
    cbz     x0, Linternal
    mov     x27, x0
    sub     x2, x21, x22                // bytes already buffered past headers
    cmp     x2, x26
    csel    x2, x2, x26, lo
    mov     x28, x2
    add     x1, x20, x22
    bl      _memcpy
Lbody_more:
    cmp     x28, x26
    b.hs    Lroute
    mov     w0, w19
    add     x1, x27, x28
    sub     x2, x26, x28
    bl      _read
    cmp     x0, #0
    b.gt    1f
    b.eq    Lclose
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w8, [x0]
    cmp     w8, #EINTR
    b.eq    Lbody_more
    b       Lclose
1:  add     x28, x28, x0
    b       Lbody_more

    // ---- routing ----------------------------------------------------------
Lroute:
    // classify the method (the buffer is HDR_CAP bytes, so 8-byte loads are safe)
    mov     x21, #M_OTHER
    ldr     x9, [x20]
    cmp     x23, #3
    b.ne    1f
    and     w10, w9, #0xffffff
    movz    w11, #0x4547
    movk    w11, #0x54, lsl #16         // "GET"
    mov     x12, #M_GET
    cmp     w10, w11
    csel    x21, x12, x21, eq
    movz    w11, #0x5550
    movk    w11, #0x54, lsl #16         // "PUT"
    mov     x12, #M_PUT
    cmp     w10, w11
    csel    x21, x12, x21, eq
    b       2f
1:  cmp     x23, #6
    b.ne    2f
    and     x10, x9, #0xffffffffffff
    movz    x11, #0x4544
    movk    x11, #0x454c, lsl #16
    movk    x11, #0x4554, lsl #32       // "DELETE"
    mov     x12, #M_DELETE
    cmp     x10, x11
    csel    x21, x12, x21, eq
2:
    // "/health"
    cmp     x25, #7
    b.ne    Lroute_kv
    ldr     x10, [x24]
    and     x10, x10, #0x00ffffffffffffff
    movz    x11, #0x682f
    movk    x11, #0x6165, lsl #16
    movk    x11, #0x746c, lsl #32
    movk    x11, #0x0068, lsl #48
    cmp     x10, x11
    b.ne    Lroute_kv
    cmp     x21, #M_GET
    b.ne    Lnot_allowed
    adrp    x8, Lok_body@PAGE
    add     x8, x8, Lok_body@PAGEOFF
    mov     x9, #2
    stp     x8, x9, [sp, #F_RBODY]
    mov     w28, #200
    b       Lrespond

Lroute_kv:
    // "/kv" or "/kv/<key>"
    cmp     x25, #3
    b.lo    Lnot_found
    ldr     w10, [x24]
    and     w11, w10, #0xffffff
    movz    w12, #0x6b2f
    movk    w12, #0x76, lsl #16         // "/kv"
    cmp     w11, w12
    b.ne    Lnot_found
    cmp     x25, #3
    b.eq    Lkv_root
    lsr     w11, w10, #24
    cmp     w11, #'/'
    b.ne    Lnot_found

    add     x0, x24, #4
    sub     x1, x25, #4
    bl      Lvalid_key
    cbz     w0, Lbad_request
    add     x0, x24, #4
    sub     x1, x25, #4
    cmp     x21, #M_GET
    b.eq    Lkv_get
    cmp     x21, #M_PUT
    b.eq    Lkv_put
    cmp     x21, #M_DELETE
    b.eq    Lkv_delete
    b       Lnot_allowed

Lkv_get:
    add     x2, sp, #F_RBODY
    add     x3, sp, #F_RLEN
    bl      _kv_get
    mov     w28, w0
    ldr     x8, [sp, #F_RBODY]
    str     x8, [sp, #F_RFREE]
    b       Lrespond

Lkv_put:
    mov     x2, x27                     // ownership moves to the store
    mov     x3, x26
    mov     x27, #0
    bl      _kv_put
    mov     w28, w0
    b       Lrespond

Lkv_delete:
    bl      _kv_delete
    mov     w28, w0
    b       Lrespond

Lkv_root:
    cmp     x21, #M_GET
    b.ne    Lnot_allowed
    add     x0, sp, #F_RBODY
    add     x1, sp, #F_RLEN
    bl      _kv_list
    mov     w28, w0
    ldr     x8, [sp, #F_RBODY]
    str     x8, [sp, #F_RFREE]
    cmp     w28, #200
    cset    w8, eq
    str     w8, [sp, #F_JSON]
    b       Lrespond

Lbad_request:
    mov     w28, #400
    b       Lrespond
Lnot_found:
    mov     w28, #404
    b       Lrespond
Lnot_allowed:
    mov     w28, #405
    b       Lrespond
Ltoo_large:
    mov     w28, #413
    b       Lrespond
Linternal:
    mov     w28, #500

    // ---- response ---------------------------------------------------------
Lrespond:
    mov     w0, w28
    bl      Lstatus_line                // x1 = "HTTP/1.1 NNN Reason\r\n"
    add     x0, sp, #F_HDR
    bl      Lappend
    ldr     w8, [sp, #F_JSON]
    cbz     w8, 1f
    adrp    x1, Lhdr_json@PAGE
    add     x1, x1, Lhdr_json@PAGEOFF
    bl      Lappend
1:  adrp    x1, Lhdr_length@PAGE
    add     x1, x1, Lhdr_length@PAGEOFF
    bl      Lappend
    ldr     x1, [sp, #F_RLEN]
    bl      Lappend_u64
    adrp    x1, Lhdr_tail@PAGE
    add     x1, x1, Lhdr_tail@PAGEOFF
    bl      Lappend

    add     x8, sp, #F_HDR
    sub     x9, x0, x8
    stp     x8, x9, [sp, #F_IOV]
    ldp     x10, x11, [sp, #F_RBODY]
    stp     x10, x11, [sp, #F_IOV + 16]
    mov     w0, w19
    add     x1, sp, #F_IOV
    mov     w2, #2
    bl      Lwritev_all

Lclose:
    ldr     x0, [sp, #F_RFREE]
    bl      _free
    mov     x0, x27
    bl      _free
    mov     x0, x20
    bl      _free
    mov     w0, w19
    bl      _close
    mov     x0, #0
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #F_REGS + 80]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #F_REGS + 64]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #F_REGS + 48]
    ldp     x24, x23, [sp, #F_REGS + 32]
    ldp     x26, x25, [sp, #F_REGS + 16]
    ldp     x28, x27, [sp, #F_REGS]
    add     sp, sp, #F_SIZE
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lcontent_length — leaf.  x0 = first header line, x1 = end of headers
// (just past "\r\n\r\n").  Returns x0 = Content-Length (0 if absent) or -1
// if the value is malformed.  The region always ends in CRLF CRLF, which
// bounds every scan below.
    .p2align 2
Lcontent_length:
    .cfi_startproc
    mov     x9, #0
    adrp    x10, Lcl_name@PAGE
    add     x10, x10, Lcl_name@PAGEOFF
Lcl_line:
    cmp     x0, x1
    b.hs    Lcl_done
    mov     x2, #0
Lcl_cmp:                                // case-insensitive "content-length:"
    ldrb    w3, [x10, x2]
    cbz     w3, Lcl_match
    ldrb    w4, [x0, x2]
    sub     w5, w4, #'A'
    cmp     w5, #25
    b.hi    1f
    orr     w4, w4, #0x20
1:  cmp     w4, w3
    b.ne    Lcl_skip
    add     x2, x2, #1
    b       Lcl_cmp
Lcl_match:
    add     x0, x0, x2
2:  ldrb    w4, [x0]                    // leading OWS
    cmp     w4, #CH_SP
    b.eq    3f
    cmp     w4, #CH_TAB
    b.ne    4f
3:  add     x0, x0, #1
    b       2b
4:  mov     x9, #0
    mov     x6, #0                      // digit count
    mov     x7, #10
5:  ldrb    w4, [x0]
    sub     w5, w4, #'0'
    cmp     w5, #9
    b.hi    6f
    madd    x9, x9, x7, x5
    add     x6, x6, #1
    cmp     x6, #18                     // keeps the value well inside int64
    b.hi    Lcl_bad
    add     x0, x0, #1
    b       5b
6:  cbz     x6, Lcl_bad
7:  cmp     w4, #CH_SP                  // trailing OWS, then CR
    b.eq    8f
    cmp     w4, #CH_TAB
    b.ne    9f
8:  add     x0, x0, #1
    ldrb    w4, [x0]
    b       7b
9:  cmp     w4, #CH_CR
    b.ne    Lcl_bad
Lcl_skip:
    ldrb    w4, [x0], #1
    cmp     w4, #CH_LF
    b.ne    Lcl_skip
    b       Lcl_line
Lcl_done:
    mov     x0, x9
    ret
Lcl_bad:
    mov     x0, #-1
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lvalid_key — leaf.  x0 = ptr, x1 = len.  w0 = 1 if [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}.
    .p2align 2
Lvalid_key:
    .cfi_startproc
    sub     x2, x1, #1
    cmp     x2, #63
    b.hi    Lkey_bad
1:  ldrb    w3, [x0], #1
    sub     w4, w3, #'0'
    cmp     w4, #9
    b.ls    2f
    orr     w4, w3, #0x20
    sub     w4, w4, #'a'
    cmp     w4, #25
    b.ls    2f
    cmp     w3, #'_'
    b.eq    2f
    cmp     w3, #'-'
    b.ne    Lkey_bad
2:  subs    x1, x1, #1
    b.ne    1b
    mov     w0, #1
    ret
Lkey_bad:
    mov     w0, #0
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lstatus_line — leaf.  w0 = status code.  x1 = full status line string.
    .macro STATUS code, label
    cmp     w0, #\code
    b.ne    1f
    adrp    x1, \label@PAGE
    add     x1, x1, \label@PAGEOFF
    ret
1:
    .endm

    .p2align 2
Lstatus_line:
    .cfi_startproc
    STATUS  200, Ls200
    STATUS  201, Ls201
    STATUS  204, Ls204
    STATUS  400, Ls400
    STATUS  404, Ls404
    STATUS  405, Ls405
    STATUS  413, Ls413
    adrp    x1, Ls500@PAGE
    add     x1, x1, Ls500@PAGEOFF
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lappend — leaf.  Copy NUL-terminated x1 to x0; return x0 = end of copy.
    .p2align 2
Lappend:
    .cfi_startproc
1:  ldrb    w2, [x1], #1
    cbz     w2, 2f
    strb    w2, [x0], #1
    b       1b
2:  ret
    .cfi_endproc

// Lappend_u64 — leaf.  Write x1 in decimal at x0; return x0 = end.
    .p2align 2
Lappend_u64:
    .cfi_startproc
    mov     x4, #10
    mov     x2, x1
    mov     x3, #0
1:  udiv    x2, x2, x4                  // count digits
    add     x3, x3, #1
    cbnz    x2, 1b
    add     x0, x0, x3
    mov     x5, x0
2:  udiv    x2, x1, x4                  // emit back to front
    msub    x6, x2, x4, x1
    add     w6, w6, #'0'
    strb    w6, [x5, #-1]!
    mov     x1, x2
    cbnz    x1, 2b
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lwritev_all — w0 = fd, x1 = iovec array (modified), w2 = count.
// Writes everything, retrying on EINTR and short writes.  w0 = 0 / -1.
    .p2align 2
Lwritev_all:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #-48]!
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #16]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #32]
    add     x29, sp, #32
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    mov     w19, w0
    mov     x20, x1
    mov     w21, w2
Lwv_skip:                               // drop exhausted leading iovecs
    cbz     w21, Lwv_ok
    ldr     x8, [x20, #8]
    cbnz    x8, Lwv_write
    add     x20, x20, #16
    sub     w21, w21, #1
    b       Lwv_skip
Lwv_write:
    mov     w0, w19
    mov     x1, x20
    mov     w2, w21
    bl      _writev
    tbz     x0, #63, Lwv_advance
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w8, [x0]
    cmp     w8, #EINTR
    b.eq    Lwv_write
    mov     w0, #-1
    b       Lwv_ret
Lwv_advance:                            // consume x0 bytes from the iovecs
    cbz     x0, Lwv_skip
    ldp     x9, x8, [x20]
    cmp     x0, x8
    b.lo    1f
    sub     x0, x0, x8
    str     xzr, [x20, #8]
    add     x20, x20, #16
    sub     w21, w21, #1
    cbz     w21, Lwv_ok
    b       Lwv_advance
1:  add     x9, x9, x0
    sub     x8, x8, x0
    stp     x9, x8, [x20]
    b       Lwv_skip
Lwv_ok:
    mov     w0, #0
Lwv_ret:
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp], #48
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    .section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
Lok_body:       .asciz "ok"
Lcl_name:       .asciz "content-length:"
Lhdr_json:      .asciz "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
Lhdr_length:    .asciz "Content-Length: "
Lhdr_tail:      .asciz "\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
Ls200:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
Ls201:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n"
Ls204:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\r\n"
Ls400:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request\r\n"
Ls404:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n"
Ls405:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed\r\n"
Ls413:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 413 Content Too Large\r\n"
Ls500:          .asciz "HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error\r\n"

.subsections_via_symbols

// main.s — `app <port>`: listen on 127.0.0.1:<port>, one detached thread
// per accepted connection (see conn.s), serve until killed.

    .equ AF_INET, 2
    .equ SOCK_STREAM, 1
    .equ SOL_SOCKET, 0xffff
    .equ SO_REUSEADDR, 4
    .equ SIGPIPE, 13
    .equ SIG_IGN, 1
    .equ PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED, 2
    .equ BACKLOG, 1024
    .equ ENFILE, 23
    .equ EMFILE, 24
    .equ EINTR, 4

    // frame (sp-relative)
    .equ F_ATTR, 0                  // pthread_attr_t (64 bytes)
    .equ F_ADDR, 64                 // struct sockaddr_in (16 bytes)
    .equ F_TID,  80                 // pthread_t
    .equ F_END,  88                 // strtol end pointer
    .equ F_ONE,  96                 // int 1 for setsockopt
    .equ F_REGS, 112
    .equ F_SIZE, 144

    .text
    .globl  _main
    .p2align 2
_main:
    .cfi_startproc
    sub     sp, sp, #F_SIZE
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #F_REGS]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #F_REGS + 16]
    add     x29, sp, #F_REGS + 16
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32

    // port = strtol(argv[1]); must be a full decimal in 1..65535
    cmp     w0, #2
    b.ne    Lusage
    ldr     x0, [x1, #8]
    add     x1, sp, #F_END
    mov     w2, #10
    bl      _strtol
    ldr     x8, [sp, #F_END]
    ldrb    w8, [x8]
    cbnz    w8, Lusage
    sub     x8, x0, #1
    mov     x9, #65534
    cmp     x8, x9
    b.hi    Lusage
    mov     w19, w0

    // a client hanging up mid-write must not kill the process
    mov     w0, #SIGPIPE
    mov     x1, #SIG_IGN
    bl      _signal

    mov     w0, #AF_INET
    mov     w1, #SOCK_STREAM
    mov     w2, #0
    bl      _socket
    tbnz    w0, #31, Lfail_socket
    mov     w20, w0

    mov     w8, #1
    str     w8, [sp, #F_ONE]
    mov     w0, w20
    mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
    mov     w2, #SO_REUSEADDR
    add     x3, sp, #F_ONE
    mov     w4, #4
    bl      _setsockopt

    // sockaddr_in { sin_len = 16, sin_family = AF_INET, sin_port, 127.0.0.1 }
    rev16   w9, w19
    mov     w8, #(AF_INET << 8) | 16
    orr     w8, w8, w9, lsl #16
    str     w8, [sp, #F_ADDR]
    movz    w9, #0x007f
    movk    w9, #0x0100, lsl #16
    str     w9, [sp, #F_ADDR + 4]
    str     xzr, [sp, #F_ADDR + 8]
    mov     w0, w20
    add     x1, sp, #F_ADDR
    mov     w2, #16
    bl      _bind
    cbnz    w0, Lfail_bind
    mov     w0, w20
    mov     w1, #BACKLOG
    bl      _listen
    cbnz    w0, Lfail_listen

    add     x0, sp, #F_ATTR
    bl      _pthread_attr_init
    add     x0, sp, #F_ATTR
    mov     w1, #PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED
    bl      _pthread_attr_setdetachstate

Laccept:
    mov     w0, w20
    mov     x1, #0
    mov     x2, #0
    bl      _accept
    tbnz    w0, #31, Laccept_error
    mov     w19, w0
    add     x0, sp, #F_TID
    add     x1, sp, #F_ATTR
    adrp    x2, _conn_main@PAGE
    add     x2, x2, _conn_main@PAGEOFF
    mov     w3, w19                     // fd travels as the thread argument
    bl      _pthread_create
    cbz     w0, Laccept
    mov     w0, w19                     // no thread: shed the connection
    bl      _close
    b       Laccept

Laccept_error:
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w8, [x0]
    cmp     w8, #EMFILE
    ccmp    w8, #ENFILE, #4, ne         // Z set if EMFILE or ENFILE
    b.ne    Laccept
    mov     w0, #10000                  // out of descriptors: back off 10 ms
    bl      _usleep
    b       Laccept

Lusage:
    adrp    x0, Lmsg_usage@PAGE
    add     x0, x0, Lmsg_usage@PAGEOFF
    adrp    x1, ___stderrp@GOTPAGE
    ldr     x1, [x1, ___stderrp@GOTPAGEOFF]
    ldr     x1, [x1]
    bl      _fputs
    mov     w0, #2
    b       Lexit
Lfail_socket:
    adrp    x0, Lmsg_socket@PAGE
    add     x0, x0, Lmsg_socket@PAGEOFF
    b       Lfail
Lfail_bind:
    adrp    x0, Lmsg_bind@PAGE
    add     x0, x0, Lmsg_bind@PAGEOFF
    b       Lfail
Lfail_listen:
    adrp    x0, Lmsg_listen@PAGE
    add     x0, x0, Lmsg_listen@PAGEOFF
Lfail:
    bl      _perror
    mov     w0, #1
Lexit:
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #F_REGS + 16]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #F_REGS]
    add     sp, sp, #F_SIZE
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// store.s — thread-safe in-memory key/value store.
//
// Representation: a dense array of entry pointers kept sorted by key
// (byte-wise, shorter-prefix first).  Lookup is a binary search; insert and
// delete shift the pointer array with memmove.  Sorted order makes the
// `GET /kv` listing a straight walk.  One global mutex guards everything.
//
// Public interface (all return an HTTP status code in w0):
//   int kv_put(const char *key, size_t klen, void *val, size_t vlen)
//         201 new, 200 replaced, 500 OOM.  Takes ownership of `val`
//         (malloc'd or NULL when vlen == 0) in every case.
//   int kv_get(const char *key, size_t klen, void **out, size_t *outlen)
//         200 with a malloc'd copy in *out, 404 absent, 500 OOM.
//   int kv_delete(const char *key, size_t klen)
//         204 deleted, 404 absent.
//   int kv_list(void **out, size_t *outlen)
//         200 with a malloc'd JSON array of all keys, 500 OOM.

    // entry layout (malloc'd, E_SIZE bytes)
    .equ E_KLEN,   0            // size_t key length (1..64)
    .equ E_VAL,    8            // void * value bytes (may be NULL if empty)
    .equ E_VLEN,  16            // size_t value length
    .equ E_KEY,   24            // char key[64]
    .equ E_SIZE,  88

    // store layout
    .equ S_LOCK,     0          // pthread_mutex_t (64 bytes)
    .equ S_ENTRIES, 64          // entry **, sorted
    .equ S_COUNT,   72          // size_t
    .equ S_CAP,     80          // size_t (capacity of S_ENTRIES)

    .equ INITIAL_CAP, 64

    .data
    .p2align 3
Lstore:
    .quad 0x32AAABA7            // PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER signature
    .space 56
    .quad 0                     // entries
    .quad 0                     // count
    .quad 0                     // cap

    .text

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// kv_find_locked — binary search (leaf, caller holds the lock).
//   in:  x0 = key, x1 = klen, x2 = store base
//   out: x0 = index (match or insertion point), x1 = 1 if found else 0
// Clobbers x3-x15.
    .private_extern _kv_find_locked
    .p2align 2
_kv_find_locked:
    ldr     x8, [x2, #S_ENTRIES]
    ldr     x9, [x2, #S_COUNT]          // hi
    mov     x10, #0                     // lo
Lfind_loop:
    cmp     x10, x9
    b.hs    Lfind_miss
    add     x11, x10, x9
    lsr     x11, x11, #1                // mid
    ldr     x12, [x8, x11, lsl #3]
    ldr     x13, [x12, #E_KLEN]
    add     x14, x12, #E_KEY
    cmp     x1, x13
    csel    x15, x1, x13, lo            // common prefix length
    mov     x3, #0
Lfind_cmp:
    cmp     x3, x15
    b.hs    Lfind_prefix
    ldrb    w4, [x0, x3]
    ldrb    w5, [x14, x3]
    add     x3, x3, #1
    cmp     w4, w5
    b.eq    Lfind_cmp
    b.lo    Lfind_less
    b       Lfind_greater
Lfind_prefix:
    cmp     x1, x13
    b.eq    Lfind_hit
    b.lo    Lfind_less
Lfind_greater:                          // key > entries[mid]
    add     x10, x11, #1
    b       Lfind_loop
Lfind_less:                             // key < entries[mid]
    mov     x9, x11
    b       Lfind_loop
Lfind_hit:
    mov     x0, x11
    mov     x1, #1
    ret
Lfind_miss:
    mov     x0, x10
    mov     x1, #0
    ret

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    .globl  _kv_put
    .p2align 2
_kv_put:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x26, x25, [sp, #-80]!
    stp     x24, x23, [sp, #16]
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #32]
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #48]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #64]
    add     x29, sp, #64
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    .cfi_offset w23, -56
    .cfi_offset w24, -64
    .cfi_offset w25, -72
    .cfi_offset w26, -80
    mov     x19, x0                     // key
    mov     x20, x1                     // klen
    mov     x21, x2                     // value
    mov     x22, x3                     // vlen
    adrp    x25, Lstore@PAGE
    add     x25, x25, Lstore@PAGEOFF
    mov     x0, x25
    bl      _pthread_mutex_lock

    mov     x0, x19
    mov     x1, x20
    mov     x2, x25
    bl      _kv_find_locked
    mov     x23, x0                     // index
    cbz     x1, Lput_new

    // replace in place; the old value is freed after unlocking
    ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
    ldr     x8, [x8, x23, lsl #3]
    ldr     x24, [x8, #E_VAL]
    stp     x21, x22, [x8, #E_VAL]
    mov     w26, #200
    b       Lput_unlock

Lput_new:
    ldp     x8, x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]     // count, cap
    cmp     x8, x9
    b.lo    Lput_alloc
    lsl     x9, x9, #1
    mov     x10, #INITIAL_CAP
    cmp     x9, x10
    csel    x26, x9, x10, hs            // new cap = max(2*cap, INITIAL_CAP)
    ldr     x0, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
    lsl     x1, x26, #3
    bl      _realloc
    cbz     x0, Lput_fail
    str     x0, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
    str     x26, [x25, #S_CAP]
Lput_alloc:
    mov     x0, #E_SIZE
    bl      _malloc
    cbz     x0, Lput_fail
    mov     x24, x0
    str     x20, [x24, #E_KLEN]
    stp     x21, x22, [x24, #E_VAL]
    add     x0, x24, #E_KEY
    mov     x1, x19
    mov     x2, x20
    bl      _memcpy
    // open a slot: memmove(&e[idx+1], &e[idx], (count-idx)*8)
    ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
    ldr     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
    add     x1, x8, x23, lsl #3
    add     x0, x1, #8
    sub     x2, x9, x23
    lsl     x2, x2, #3
    bl      _memmove
    ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
    str     x24, [x8, x23, lsl #3]
    ldr     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
    add     x9, x9, #1
    str     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
    mov     x24, #0                     // nothing to free
    mov     w26, #201

Lput_unlock:
    mov     x0, x25
    bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
    mov     x0, x24
    bl      _free
    mov     w0, w26
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #64]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #48]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x24, x23, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x26, x25, [sp], #80
    ret

Lput_fail:
    mov     x24, x21                    // drop the value we were handed
    mov     w26, #500
    b       Lput_unlock
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    .globl  _kv_get
    .p2align 2
_kv_get:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x24, x23, [sp, #-64]!
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #16]
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #32]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #48]
    add     x29, sp, #48
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    .cfi_offset w23, -56
    .cfi_offset w24, -64
    mov     x19, x0
    mov     x20, x1
    mov     x21, x2                     // out
    mov     x22, x3                     // outlen
    str     xzr, [x21]
    str     xzr, [x22]
    adrp    x23, Lstore@PAGE
    add     x23, x23, Lstore@PAGEOFF
    mov     x0, x23
    bl      _pthread_mutex_lock

    mov     x0, x19
    mov     x1, x20
    mov     x2, x23
    bl      _kv_find_locked
    mov     w24, #404
    cbz     x1, Lget_unlock

    ldr     x8, [x23, #S_ENTRIES]
    ldr     x8, [x8, x0, lsl #3]
    ldp     x19, x20, [x8, #E_VAL]      // value, vlen
    cmp     x20, #0
    csinc   x0, x20, xzr, ne            // malloc(vlen ? vlen : 1)
    bl      _malloc
    mov     w24, #500
    cbz     x0, Lget_unlock
    str     x0, [x21]
    str     x20, [x22]
    mov     w24, #200
    cbz     x20, Lget_unlock
    mov     x1, x19
    mov     x2, x20
    bl      _memcpy

Lget_unlock:
    mov     x0, x23
    bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
    mov     w0, w24
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #48]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x24, x23, [sp], #64
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    .globl  _kv_delete
    .p2align 2
_kv_delete:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #-48]!
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #16]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #32]
    add     x29, sp, #32
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    mov     x19, x0
    mov     x20, x1
    adrp    x21, Lstore@PAGE
    add     x21, x21, Lstore@PAGEOFF
    mov     x0, x21
    bl      _pthread_mutex_lock

    mov     x0, x19
    mov     x1, x20
    mov     x2, x21
    bl      _kv_find_locked
    mov     x20, #0                     // entry to free
    mov     w22, #404
    cbz     x1, Ldel_unlock

    // close the gap: memmove(&e[idx], &e[idx+1], (count-idx-1)*8)
    ldr     x8, [x21, #S_ENTRIES]
    ldr     x9, [x21, #S_COUNT]
    ldr     x20, [x8, x0, lsl #3]
    sub     x2, x9, x0
    sub     x2, x2, #1
    lsl     x2, x2, #3
    sub     x9, x9, #1
    str     x9, [x21, #S_COUNT]
    add     x0, x8, x0, lsl #3
    add     x1, x0, #8
    bl      _memmove
    mov     w22, #204

Ldel_unlock:
    mov     x0, x21
    bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
    cbz     x20, Ldel_ret
    ldr     x0, [x20, #E_VAL]
    bl      _free
    mov     x0, x20
    bl      _free
Ldel_ret:
    mov     w0, w22
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp], #48
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    .globl  _kv_list
    .p2align 2
_kv_list:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x24, x23, [sp, #-64]!
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #16]
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #32]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #48]
    add     x29, sp, #48
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    .cfi_offset w23, -56
    .cfi_offset w24, -64
    mov     x19, x0                     // out
    mov     x20, x1                     // outlen
    str     xzr, [x19]
    str     xzr, [x20]
    adrp    x21, Lstore@PAGE
    add     x21, x21, Lstore@PAGEOFF
    mov     x0, x21
    bl      _pthread_mutex_lock

    ldr     x22, [x21, #S_COUNT]
    ldr     x23, [x21, #S_ENTRIES]

    // size = 2 + sum(klen + 3)   ('[' ']' plus quotes and a comma per key)
    mov     x0, #2
    mov     x8, #0
Llist_size:
    cmp     x8, x22
    b.hs    Llist_alloc
    ldr     x9, [x23, x8, lsl #3]
    ldr     x9, [x9, #E_KLEN]
    add     x0, x0, x9
    add     x0, x0, #3
    add     x8, x8, #1
    b       Llist_size
Llist_alloc:
    bl      _malloc
    mov     w24, #500
    cbz     x0, Llist_unlock
    str     x0, [x19]

    mov     x1, x0                      // write cursor
    mov     w10, #'['
    strb    w10, [x1], #1
    mov     x8, #0
Llist_key:
    cmp     x8, x22
    b.hs    Llist_close
    cbz     x8, 1f
    mov     w10, #','
    strb    w10, [x1], #1
1:  mov     w10, #'"'
    strb    w10, [x1], #1
    ldr     x9, [x23, x8, lsl #3]
    ldr     x11, [x9, #E_KLEN]
    add     x9, x9, #E_KEY
2:  ldrb    w12, [x9], #1               // klen >= 1 by invariant
    strb    w12, [x1], #1
    subs    x11, x11, #1
    b.ne    2b
    strb    w10, [x1], #1               // closing quote
    add     x8, x8, #1
    b       Llist_key
Llist_close:
    mov     w10, #']'
    strb    w10, [x1], #1
    sub     x1, x1, x0
    str     x1, [x20]
    mov     w24, #200

Llist_unlock:
    mov     x0, x21
    bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
    mov     w0, w24
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #48]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x24, x23, [sp], #64
    ret
    .cfi_endproc
